_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: Leo Wiener's Complete Works of Count Tolstoy (Dana Estes, Boston, 1904-05, 24 vols), the first complete English Tolstoy, all translated by Wiener (1862-1939) from the Russian. One title per volume. US public domain (pre-1931); UK: Wiener d. 1939, PD there since 2010. A second witness beside the Maudes', Garnett's and Hapgood's Tolstoy on their own shelves; nothing is held twice (ids checked across all branches). Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 15); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
_surname_note: Full name; every volume's title page prints 'Translated from the Original Russian and Edited by LEO WIENER'.

_verified_note: Evidence that each source's rights/identity line was read (lane C review fix, 2026-10-02, pipeline run over the fetched files; no book text recorded). PG: the header's Translator: line and the COPYRIGHTED marker. IA: whether the translator's name appears in the first 30 KB of OCR, and the years printed in the first 15 KB of front matter (scanner/digitizer lines skipped). Any post-1930 year there was examined by eye; see the title's scan_edition.
